## MAC Peripheral (Multiply-Accumulate Unit)

Memory-mapped at base address 0xFFD4 with 3 registers.
Implements pipelined multiply + accumulate with:
- Signed/unsigned multiply modes
- Signed/unsigned accumulate modes  
- Status flags: carry, overflow, zero
- Interrupt support (configurable via config register)
- Config register with writable mask: 0b1010111100000111

Classes: MAC_MULT (multiplier), MAC_ACC (accumulator), ANEMPeripheralMAC (top-level)

Peripherals are attached to data memory via ANEMDataMemory::attachPeripheral() using a std::map<addr_t, ANEMMemMappedPeripheral*> for virtual memory mapping.
